questions.question: What is the title of the white paper or report?
questions.hint: Provide the exact title as it should appear on the cover.

questions.question: What is the report about?
questions.hint: Provide a brief summary of the report's topic, findings, or purpose.

questions.question: Who is the intended audience?
questions.hint: Examples: Executives, investors, healthcare professionals, policymakers, researchers, customers, etc.

questions.question: How many pages does the report contain?
questions.hint: This helps determine spine requirements and cover layout considerations.

questions.question: What text should appear on the cover?
questions.hint: Include title, subtitle, author name, company name, publication date, edition number, or any other required content.

questions.question: Should the cover include any call to action?
What is the destination URL for the QR code?
questions.hint: Only if you selected Scan a QR Code above.

questions.question: Do you have photography, illustrations, charts, or imagery for the cover?
questions.hint: Print assets should be a minimum of 300 DPI at final print size.

questions.question: Upload print-ready assets.
questions.hint: Only if you have photography, illustrations, charts, or imagery for the cover.

questions.question: Any reference designs or inspiration?
questions.hint: Share examples, competitor reports, previous editions, or styles you admire.

questions.question: Upload reference designs, up to 3.
questions.hint: Only if you said yes to reference designs above.

questions.question: Describe the visual style you'd like.
Is this cover for print, digital PDF distribution, or both?
questions.hint: This is actually more important than asking technical requirements first because digital report covers are designed differently from printed covers.

questions.question: Any technical or print-specific requirements?
questions.hint: Leave blank if unsure — we'll use standard specifications.
